name: .416 Cal-397gr Claw Hammer®
note: Required twist rate for dangerous game hunting is 1-16″ or faster. The faster the twist the deeper and straighter the penetration. Recommended use: Dangerous Game Hunting and Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This is a true 100% weight retention solid dangerous game bullet. This dangerous game Claw Hammer™ is uniquely designed with a slight concave on the 3/8″ meplat. This allows the nose to have enough taper for reliable feeding with exceptional terminal performance, with the nose deforming to full caliber maintaining a flat frontal area, creating a large permanent wound channel. Being constructed of pure copper there is no worry about over expansion, like some lead core bullets, limiting penetration. The Claw Hammer™ will give the bone breaking, deep penetration needed for the most dangerous animals in the world."
